headlines.title: Oregon police say teacher tackled suspected shooter, who previously attended Silver Rail Elementary
headlines.description: A teacher "fought" and "tackled" the suspected shooter by throwing her cell phone at him, according to Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz. The victim, who has been identified as Griffin J. John II, previously attended Silver Rail Elementary. The investigation is still active and underway.

headlines.title: Father of two and teacher credited for saving lives at deadly school shooting that killed four
headlines.description: Authorities tonight are crediting a father of two who happened to be driving by the school on his lunch break when he heard gun shots, along with a teacher who threw a cell phone and tackled the gunman, for saving lives. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Oregon school shooting victims include 5-year-old whose family is ‘broken and lost’
headlines.description: The victims killed in a special needs classroom at an Oregon elementary school Thursday included a 5-year-old boy whose family said they are “broken and lost” after the shooting and a young teacher working her “dream job.”

headlines.title: Trump waives new Russia sanctions passed by Congress, citing ‘national interests’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump waived sweeping new sanctions against Russia passed by Congress, arguing in an executive order Friday that the move “is in the national interests of the United States.”

headlines.title: Federal investigation of letters with suspicious substances widens
headlines.description: A federal investigation of letters containing unknown substances that were mailed to elected officials’ offices has expanded as some Republicans have been identified as targets of the mailings, a person with direct knowledge of the investigation told NBC News on Friday.

headlines.title: White House Press Secretary out after 5 days on the job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia had a rocky five days as White House Press Secretary with a single briefing that was widely panned followed by questions over her legal credentials. Now she is out from one of the highest profile posts of the Trump administration. NBC News’ Chief White House Correspondent Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
headlines.description: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses child sexual abuse charges against actor Timothy Busfield
headlines.description: A New Mexico judge dismissed child sexual abuse charges against "West Wing" and "Field of Dreams" actor Timothy Busfield over prosecutor misconduct. Busfield has repeatedly denied the allegations, describing them as lies motivated by revenge.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Benjamin Satterley, wrestler known as Pac, died of bronchial asthma
headlines.description: Benjamin Satterley, known to wrestling fans around the world as Pac, died last month of bronchial asthma, the medical examiner’s office in Cook County, Illinois, confirmed Friday.

headlines.description: President Donald Trump waived sweeping new sanctions against Russia passed by Congress, arguing in an executive order Friday that the move “is in the national interests of the United States.”

headlines.title: Immigrant ICE was seeking when it hit man with SUV has been dead since 2017, family says
headlines.description: An immigrant rights group is calling for ICE to “come clean” about its pursuit of Jose Parra Hernández and to release bodycam video.
